name: IM-1 Odysseus
note: Landed near Malapert A on 22 February 2024 and returned surface data despite tipping. Coordinates represent the approximate landing region. The displayed touchdown Sun angle is a geometry estimate, not a reconstruction of panel power. Refined trajectory analyses place the touchdown near 80.13 S, 1.44 E; the displayed site keeps the original reported coordinates for consistency with its duty-cycle series.
sources: Provider and NASA mission records. Curated snapshot, not a live manifest.

name: IM-2 Athena
note: Landed in a crater in the Mons Mouton region on 6 March 2025. NASA reported an early end of mission after some data were collected. Sun elevation alone does not explain the outcome; terrain, lander orientation and thermal conditions also matter.
sources: Provider and NASA mission records. Curated snapshot, not a live manifest.

name: Griffin Mission One
target: Nobile Crater region, lunar south pole
note: In final integration and environmental testing after repeated slips; carries the Astrolab FLIP rover after NASA's VIPER rover was cancelled in 2024. The next candidate CLPS launch.
sources: NASA CLPS announcements and provider mission pages. Curated snapshot, not a live manifest.
